properties.name: Next AI

properties.licence: address published on the organisation's own website; reused as fact with attribution
properties.notes: An AI-specific accelerator, unlike the Regional Innovation Centres, which serve every sector. The source says the programme is "predominantly held in-person at NEXT Canada's HQ in downtown Toronto", and the point is that head office, whose address NEXT Canada publishes on the same site. The programme itself has no separate premises, so this is where it happens rather than where it is registered.
